items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: He made it all right with me.

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you -- oh, it's Lockjaw. I wanted to ask you about Lockjaw. Where did you hear lockjaw?
Lockjaw? Lockjaw was quite young and I think -- where did I hear Lockjaw? It was down at Minton's, I think. I think I heard him down at Minton's, jamming.
